title: Dependency Audit Exceptions
description: High/critical vulnerabilities that are accepted for a limited time with documented compensating controls. Every entry must include owner, rationale, compensating_control, ISO 8601 expiry, and review_trigger. Only GHSA advisories are accepted; unmatched advisories always fail closed.

exceptions.rationale: This CVE (RSC Mode CSRF Bypass) only affects React Server Components mode. This project is a Vite SPA; it does not use React Router framework mode, server rendering, or any RSC (React Server Components) API. There is no react-router.config.ts file, no server entry point, and no 'use server' directives.
exceptions.compensating_control: ARCHITECTURE INVARIANT (automated in CI): No react-router.config.{ts,js,mjs} file exists in app/web/. If one is added, this exception is invalidated immediately regardless of expiry. The project uses @vitejs/plugin-react with a standard client-side SPA entry point.
exceptions.review_trigger: Re-evaluate when react-router-dom >=8.3.0 ships with the fix, OR if SSR/RSC framework (Next.js/Remix/React Router framework mode) is introduced. Also re-evaluate if react-router.config.{ts,js,mjs} appears in the web directory.
